_about: The game's own UI text in this language (already shipped in the game). Reuse these terms whenever the store text names the same thing, so the store page matches what the player sees in the game. They also show how the game addresses the player (formal / informal).

terms.where: Tool name (carpet strip and shop). A hand scraper blade that scrapes dried crust and mud off the carpet.
Tool name. A vacuum cleaner for dry dust and crumbs.
Tool name. A water hose with a spray nozzle: wets the carpet and rinses it.
Tool name. Sprays cleaning foam (carpet shampoo / detergent foam).
Tool name. A rotary scrubbing brush (a floor-scrubber machine with a spinning brush head).
Tool name. A rubber squeegee that pushes water off the carpet.
Tool name. A wet vacuum / extractor that sucks up water and foam.
Tool name. A carpet dryer / air mover blowing warm air.
Floor tool name (right strip). Sprays floor detergent on the tiles.
Floor tool name (right strip). A mop for the tiles.
Big green button that appears when the carpet is clean: give the carpet back to its owner (the client) and get paid. Hotkey H.
Top-right button that opens the upgrade shop (hotkey U, shown on a key chip next to it).
Caption at the top of the upgrade shop.
Big title of the upgrade shop: improve your cleaning equipment.
Upgrade stat name on every tool card: how strongly and fast the tool works.
Upgrade stat name on every tool card: how wide an area the tool covers in one stroke.
Legend under the shop title explaining the POWER stat.
Legend explaining the AREA stat.
Pay slip line: bonus for finishing fast.
Pay slip line: bonus for a 100 % clean carpet.
Pay slip line: bonus for a 100 % dry carpet.
Pay slip line: bonus for spotless AND bone dry together.
Big stamp slammed onto the corner of the pay slip for a combo.
Pay slip line: the base payment for the job.
Caption at the top of the pay slip card that appears after a hand-over.
Shop caption above the two inspection-lamp items.
One-time shop item (key Z): a lamp mode that makes wet spots glow.
